verdict.rationale: Conta Simples is a corporate card and expense platform, so an employee reimbursement workflow is a fair question for it. The evidence covers corporate and virtual cards, receipt linking to existing card transactions, Pix and batch payments, and an approvals area. None of it documents an employee submitting an out-of-pocket expense, being reimbursed by deposit, or tracking that claim from submission to payout. Generic payment and approval features are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an employee, I can submit an out-of-pocket expense and get reimbursed by direct deposit in days, tracked from submission to payout
